items.title: After eighteen years of jaggedy bowling, a new mod bestows GTA 4 with DLSS and FSR support
items.excerpt: A new community mod adds DLSS and FSR upscaling to 2008's GTA IV, giving the game a sharper, modern AI-reconstructed image.

items.title: Starform's Lou Fasulo on staying at 26 people, AI-native development and who really funds a live game
items.excerpt: The Metalstorm studio head says AI gave his 26-person team more throughput, not new capability, and explains where AI-native development stops.

items.title: DLSS-NR-on-AMD Developer Delivers 74% Performance Boost On Radeon GPUs In A Single Day
items.excerpt: DLSS-NR-on-AMD Alpha 0.4.0 boosts Radeon performance by 74% in DLSS 5 neural rendering, pushing Cyberpunk 2077 from 30 to 50 fps at 3440x1440. Note: DLSS 5 modding thread overlaps prior coverage (open-source Vulkan reimplementation); curator should weigh as follow-up.
